externalId.title: External ID
externalId.description: Caller-owned CRM, spreadsheet, or location key returned unchanged.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Caller-provided canonical phone normalized to digits for comparison.

address.title: Address
address.description: Caller-provided canonical street address when supplied.

city.title: City
city.description: Caller-provided city used for search precision.

state.title: State or region
state.description: Caller-provided state, province, or region when supplied.

country.title: Search country
country.description: Country configured for Google directory discovery.

directoriesChecked.title: Directories checked
directoriesChecked.description: Number of fixed directory domains searched for this business.

directoriesFound.title: Directories found
directoriesFound.description: Directories with a same-domain organic search result.

directoriesMissing.title: Directories missing
directoriesMissing.description: Directories without a same-domain organic result in the inspected search result set. This is not proof the directory has no listing.

directoriesWithObservedMismatch.title: Directories with observed mismatch
directoriesWithObservedMismatch.description: Found directories where an observed comparison signal disagreed with canonical caller input.

directoriesWithInsufficientEvidence.title: Directories with insufficient evidence
directoriesWithInsufficientEvidence.description: Found directories whose snippet did not expose enough NAP evidence to assess every supplied signal.

observedCitationHealthScore.title: Observed citation health score
observedCitationHealthScore.description: 0 to 100 transparency score calculated from discovered coverage and complete non-mismatching snippet evidence; it is not a ranking, visibility, or sync guarantee.

directories.title: Directory evidence
directories.description: One source-linked finding per directory, including match states and search query.

source.title: Source
source.description: Provenance for directory discovery and snippet evidence.

sourceRunId.title: Source run ID
sourceRunId.description: ID of the owned Google SERP sub-run used for this business when available.

collectedAt.title: Collected at
collectedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the audit record was created.
